entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. The pulse reader is complete garbage. It doesn't work at all.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse feature. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the sensor or a matter of preference?
It's a fault! It's broken! It's giving me readings that are all over the place. I don't have time to mess around with troubleshooting. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand your frustration. For a potential defect, our standard process is to connect you with our technical support team to verify the issue before we can authorize a return.

Absolutely not! I'm a VIP member, you can look it up. I'm not wasting my day on the phone with your tech people. This product is garbage and your company's service so far is matching it! Just process the return or get me your manager. I will light you guys up on every review site.

That won't be necessary, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. Let me just pull up your account and review the purchase details. I see you are indeed a VIP member, and we truly value your business. Please give me just one moment to check the policy.

Okay, I've got your order here. It looks like it was delivered 35 days ago. According to our policy, items can be returned within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can definitely process that return for you right now.
Finally! Thank you. See, that wasn't so hard, was it?

Not at all, and again, my apologies for the trouble. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next 10 minutes. Because this was a defective unit and for the frustration it caused you as a VIP member, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase.
Oh. Okay, a credit is fine. As long as I'm getting the full refund for this sensor. That's the main thing.
Absolutely. The full amount will be refunded to your original payment method as soon as our warehouse receives the item. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
